dataset_sentence: The base dataset contains 5,000 products, 10,000 users, 20,000 orders, 50,000 order items, 30,000 reviews, 5,000 inventory rows. The medium dataset contains 25,000 products, 50,000 users, 100,000 orders, 250,000 order items, 150,000 reviews, 25,000 inventory rows. The largest dataset contains 100,000 products, 200,000 users, 400,000 orders, 1,000,000 order items, 600,000 reviews, 100,000 inventory rows. Each dataset has ten categories, fifty tags and an unused empty product-tag relation. Counts are rederived after loading.
